queries.sql:
WITH exploded AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.rowid AS rid,
         TRIM(json_extract(je.value, '$.code')) AS code,
         CASE
           WHEN TRIM(p.filing_date) GLOB '*[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM(p.filing_date), -4) AS INTEGER)
           WHEN TRIM(p.filing_date) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]*' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM(p.filing_date), 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
           ELSE NULL
         END AS yr
  FROM publicationinfo p, json_each(p.cpc) je
)
SELECT code, yr, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM exploded
WHERE yr IS NOT NULL AND code IS NOT NULL AND code <> ''
GROUP BY code, yr
ORDER BY code, yr;
filters: NOT yr IS NULL AND NOT code IS NULL AND code <> ''
queries.canonical: WITH exploded AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.rowid AS rid, TRIM(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(je.value, '$.code')) AS code, CASE WHEN TRIM(p.filing_date) GLOB '*[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(TRIM(p.filing_date), -4) AS INT) WHEN TRIM(p.filing_date) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]*' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(TRIM(p.filing_date), 1, 4) AS INT) ELSE NULL END AS yr FROM publicationinfo AS p CROSS JOIN JSON_EACH(p.cpc) AS je) SELECT code, yr, COUNT(*) AS n FROM exploded WHERE NOT yr IS NULL AND NOT code IS NULL AND code <> '' GROUP BY code, yr ORDER BY code, yr
